extra_text: A Florida AMBER Alert has been issued for Zaynah Obidy, a white female, 5 years old, 3 feet 6 inches tall, 65 pounds, brown hair and brown eyes and Zain Obidy, a white male, 6 years old, 4 feet tall, 90 pounds, brown hair and brown eyes. The children may be in the company of Max Carias-Carrilo, a white-hispanic male, 5 feet 8 inches tall, 170 pounds, bald hair and brown eyes. Max has a very thick beard that does not have a mustache.
